name: ask_user
description: Ask the person who gave you the task a question and wait for the answer. Use it only when you cannot proceed without it, or to get explicit consent (for example to open a pull request with failing checks). Be specific. To ask several questions with fixed answers at once, pass `choices`: the person gets one form with a list of options per question and answers them together; their answers come back as the result. Without `choices` the question is plain text.

choices.description: Questions with fixed answers, asked together as one form (at most 8). Omit for an open question.

id.description: A short id for the question (letters, digits, - _ . :), used in the answer; defaults to q1, q2, ...

options.description: The answers to pick from: 2 to 8, each a label or {value, label, description}

value.description: A short id for the option (letters, digits, - _ . :); made from the label when omitted

allowOther.description: Offer an "Other" the person can write

required.description: The person must answer this one (the default)
